meaning.4: validated in the intended-use domain with operational feedback

factors.description: Clear proposed use, accepted use, boundaries and prohibited uses.
Relevant mechanisms, abstractions, omissions and alternatives are justified.
Development and validation data source, quality, breadth and provenance.
Assumptions are explicit, versioned, testable, risk-ranked and reviewed.
Code implements the conceptual and mathematical specification correctly.
Numerical error, convergence and solver adequacy are assessed.
Outputs are compared with suitable referent or held-out data.
Input, model, numerical and derived-result uncertainty are characterized.
Sensitivity, alternative structures, seeds and stress scenarios are assessed.
Actual-use input source, quality, diversity, form and snapshot are documented.
Configuration, version, defects, records and archival are controlled.
